headline: US stocks extended losses as oil topped $100 and hot PPI data lifted Treasury yields and Fed hike odds ahead of CPI
raw_text:
- The S&P 500 (SPX) closed at 7,591.70 (-0.58%), the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJI) at 52,064.10 (-0.60%), and the Nasdaq Composite (COMP) at 26,081.72 (-0.65%), marking a fourth straight down session as market-implied odds of a Fed rate hike next week rose to around 70%.
- August PPI increased 0.4% month-over-month and 5.4% year-over-year, exceeding expectations, with energy prices a major contributor amid Iran-related Middle East conflict and Strait of Hormuz disruptions.
- Brent crude (@QA) traded around $105–$109 per barrel while WTI (@CL) moved above $100, and the 10-year Treasury yield hit multiyear highs near 4.95%.
- Energy (XLE +1.54%) led the market, while consumer staples (XLP +0.54%) also gained as Philip Morris International (PM), Constellation Brands (STZ), and Altria (MO) advanced.
- Technology (XLK -1.48%), materials, and industrial-linked names lagged, with Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) dropping 6.59% on copper (@HG) tariff uncertainty.
- Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) rose 9.79% and Qorvo (QRVO) gained 6.77% on merger momentum, while Apple (AAPL) added 3.58%.
- AeroVironment (AVAV) climbed 4.45% after reporting record revenue and backlog.
- The Cooper Companies (COO) fell 14.67% after cutting full-year guidance, while Macy’s (M) declined despite an earnings beat and Nvidia (NVDA) slipped 2.4%.
- After the bell, Oracle (ORCL) reported adjusted EPS of $1.92 versus $1.74 expected and revenue of $19.35 billion versus $19.14 billion expected, with cloud infrastructure revenue up 121% to $7.4 billion and more than $30 billion in new AI contracts, prompting a full-year guidance raise and a roughly 7% gain in the stock after hours.
- Adobe (ADBE) reported after hours with revenue of $6.76 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $6.13, both beating estimates on strong demand for AI-enabled products, while Copart (CPRT) agreed to acquire ACV Auctions in a $1.9 billion all-cash deal.

- **Energy** ([XLE](https://finviz.com/quote?t=XLE) **+1.54%**) led the market, while **consumer staples** ([XLP](https://finviz.com/quote?t=XLP) **+0.54%**) also gained as **Philip Morris International** ([PM](https://finviz.com/quote?t=PM)), **Constellation Brands** ([STZ](https://finviz.com/quote?t=STZ)), and **Altria** ([MO](https://finviz.com/quote?t=MO)) advanced.

- **Skyworks Solutions** ([SWKS](https://finviz.com/quote?t=SWKS)) rose **9.79%** and **Qorvo** ([QRVO](https://finviz.com/quote?t=QRVO)) gained **6.77%** on **merger momentum**, while **Apple** ([AAPL](https://finviz.com/quote?t=AAPL)) added **3.58%**.
- **AeroVironment** ([AVAV](https://finviz.com/quote?t=AVAV)) climbed **4.45%** after reporting **record revenue and backlog**.
- **The Cooper Companies** ([COO](https://finviz.com/quote?t=COO)) fell **14.67%** after **cutting full-year guidance**, while **Macy’s** ([M](https://finviz.com/quote?t=M)) declined despite an **earnings beat** and **Nvidia** ([NVDA](https://finviz.com/quote?t=NVDA)) slipped **2.4%**.
- After the bell, **Oracle** ([ORCL](https://finviz.com/quote?t=ORCL)) reported **adjusted EPS of $1.92 versus $1.74 expected** and **revenue of $19.35 billion versus $19.14 billion expected**, with **cloud infrastructure revenue up 121% to $7.4 billion** and **more than $30 billion in new AI contracts**, prompting a **full-year guidance raise** and a roughly **7% gain in the stock after hours**.
- **Adobe** ([ADBE](https://finviz.com/quote?t=ADBE)) reported after hours with **revenue of $6.76 billion** and **non-GAAP EPS of $6.13**, both beating estimates on strong demand for **AI-enabled products**, while **Copart** ([CPRT](https://finviz.com/quote?t=CPRT)) agreed to acquire **ACV Auctions** in a **$1.9 billion all-cash deal**.
